scope: Isolated existing browser rack only; no production docs/Android/workflow changes.

parityCases.description: Browser modules run under Node with real loopback HTTP. Prepared Float32 is compared with Node PCM24. Canonical MIDI bytes match exactly.

verification.controllerAndUi: Mock Worker/AudioContext/DOM exercise click-only download, canonical recipe controls, MIDI ownership/clearing, stale worker rejection, stop, interruption, pagehide and BFCache. No autoplay.
verification.budgets: Encoded/decoded bank declarations rejected before any WAV fetch; remaining aggregate budgets passed to the next bank. Five 4MiB padded WAV declarations require one manifest request and zero WAV requests.
verification.midiBoundary: Format1, PPQ960, bounded complete MTrk chunks, matching track count, EOT endings and no trailing bytes; not a general MIDI parser.
verification.independentReview: Confirmed pre-fetch encoded budget and second-bank remaining-budget enforcement. Canonical/nonzero-offset Uint8Array accepted; eight malformed MIDI forms rejected. Focused 44.1kHz acoustic render and stale/cancel lifecycle checks passed.

actualBrowser.navigationResult: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED for the local preview URL.
actualBrowser.previewHost: Server session also unreachable from a separate execution session. Standard local-only preview-host startup outside that isolation failed with a read-only filesystem setup error. Unused server session stopped.
actualBrowser.workarounds: No browser security flags, access-control changes or alternate publication used.

production PWA or Android background playback

limitations: Pitched sounds remain VCSL marimba and sine pad/bass/texture; no Surge/SFZ hosting in this page.
